scientific_integrity: Exact moment identities are derived independently by parity and classical logistic moments; all corrected table entries and turning points are checked by a standalone symbolic and high-precision quadrature script. Public primary source density, moment equations, and rendered table were inspected.
scientific_limitations: The comparison uses the unshifted and unscaled TASL density.
The source's analytic raw moment formulas and Figure 3 are substantially correct; the correction concerns its subsequent numerical table and qualitative interpretation.
No empirical data are refitted and the authors' unavailable computation is not inferred.
title: The TASL moment geometry contradicts its published dispersion table
